_documentation: Antigravity PreInvocation/PostToolUse hook stdin fixture. Purpose: Antigravity sends this payload on each invocation and tool use; on_sync tails transcriptPath from a saved byte offset, streams the new steps, and creates the Stash session row on first sight of conversationId. Usage: piped to `stash hook run antigravity on_sync` by test_hook_scripts_execute.py; the leading _documentation key is not a real payload field and is ignored by the hook parser.
